fields.title: Commander Free Play
fields.details: Retired from active calendar after targeted replay. The store Discord's May 31, 2026 summer schedule says Magic is no longer on the regular weekly schedule, while daily drop-in Commander/EDH play space remains supported and special MTG events may still appear. EventLink/CardCommunity currently mirrors Saturday 6 PM Commander Free Play, but that signal conflicts with the store-controlled schedule and official calendar absence, so it is preserved as evidence rather than projected as a reliable weekly planning event.

operations.reason: Remove the existing Commander series from the active calendar because the current store-controlled Discord schedule supersedes the older/ambiguous weekly Magic schedule, while preserving the row and evidence history.

fields.assessment_notes: Magic and Monsters remains a real TCG-focused Mission Viejo store with unusually good source routing: official site, official calendar, Instagram, Linktree, reviews, and an inspected Discord server. The event read is now clearer and less favorable for personal MTG planning. The official web calendar shows no MTG listings in the checked July-to-September future pages, while a current EventLink/CardCommunity mirror supports Saturday 6 PM Commander Free Play. The store Discord is the strongest current source for interpretation: its May 31, 2026 summer schedule says Magic: The Gathering is no longer on the regular weekly schedule, though daily drop-in Commander/EDH play space remains supported and prerelease, promotional, and cEDH events may still appear. Explicitly moving MTG off the regular schedule lowers the store's personal fit; treat it as a watch/special-event candidate, not a regular structured Magic target.
